en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a rural alpine village named Lavarone, with rolling green fields in the foreground, stone walls, and a man in period clothing standing near the wall. In the midground are several multi‑story buildings with red roofs and a prominent church with a tall bell tower (capella) rising above the houses. Forested hills stretch across the background under a pale sky. At the top left, red printed text reads "Lavarone, Capella, 1170 m".
